a
22∫0π/2tsin⁡t2cos2⁡t+3dt
b
2∫0π/2t(cos⁡t−sin⁡t)dt
c
2∫0π/2t(cos⁡t−sin⁡t)2dt
d
2∫0π/2tcos⁡2tdt
e
2∫0π/2tcos⁡t2cos2⁡t+1dt
